p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Repeated motifs are 5x5 blocks separated by 2-cell gutters; sample each 3x3 core.
    rs=[r for r in range(2,h-2) if r%7==2]
    cs=[c for c in range(2,w-2) if c%7==2]
    # safer derive starts from blocks of core cells at coordinates 2..4,9..11,...
    rs=list(range(2,h-1,7)); cs=list(range(2,w-1,7))
    for r in rs:
      for c in cs:
        v=grid[r][c]
        if v==0: continue
        for dr,dc in ((0,1),(1,0)):
          y,x=r+dr*7,c+dc*7
          while y<h and x<w and grid[y][x]==v:
            y+=dr*7; x+=dc*7
          if y<h and x<w and grid[y][x]==v:
            pass
          # connect to next occurrence of same color along motif row/column
          for n in range(2,10):
            yy,xx=r+dr*7*n,c+dc*7*n
            if yy>=h or xx>=w: break
            if grid[yy][xx]==v:
              for k in range(1,7*n):
                a,b=r+dr*k,c+dc*k
                if grid[a][b]==0: out[a][b]=v
              break
    return out
''')
